brief:
Hamas called on Palestinians to register and update their information in the electoral roll ahead of forthcoming Palestinian elections, the Shehab Wire reported. The movement emphasized that registration would guarantee citizens' right to participate in the vote.

The appeal comes as Palestinian factions prepare for electoral contests. Hamas did not specify a date for the elections or other procedural details in the statement.
